title: Omni TM-AE: A Scalable and Interpretable Embedding Model Using the Full Tsetlin Machine State Space
new_feature: Omni TM-AE builds reusable word embeddings in a single training phase from the full TA state matrix of the TM Autoencoder, including excluded literals: each feature's embedding component is the sum of its literal states minus its negation's states over positive-weight clauses, normalised by clause count.
